# imeihub

> Free IMEI checker and instant mobile device lookup service offering unlimited TAC brand/model identification and pay-per-check premium reports (Apple iCloud, Carrier, MDM, Warranty, GSX, Samsung Knox, and Worldwide Blacklist) with transparent USD pricing and automatic wallet refunds.

## Core Tools

- [Free IMEI Check & Lookup Tool](https://imeihub.net/): Paste any 15-digit IMEI or serial number for instant Luhn validation and free TAC-based brand, model, and hardware specs lookup. No CAPTCHA and no account required for free checks.
- [Full Service Catalog](https://imeihub.net/services.php): Complete directory of free and paid IMEI verification services with transparent per-check USD pricing.
- [Supported Brands Directory](https://imeihub.net/brands.php): Manufacturer lookup pages covering Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, Google Pixel, Motorola, Lenovo, OPPO, vivo, realme, OnePlus, Nokia, and Sony.
- [IMEI Guides & Knowledge Base](https://imeihub.net/articles.php): 135+ troubleshooting and verification guides covering Dual SIM IMEIs, carrier locks, blacklist checks, AppleCare coverage, and device diagnostics.
- [Bulk Checks, Bots & Reseller API](https://imeihub.net/api-docs): Prepaid Credit Wallet, Telegram & LINE shop bots, and JSON API onboarding for phone resellers and repair shops.
- [imeihub vs iFreeiCloud.co.uk](https://imeihub.net/vs-ifreeicloud): Side-by-side comparison of public USD pricing, iCloud/FMI checks, auto-refunds, and payment options.
- [imeihub vs IMEI.info](https://imeihub.net/vs-imei-info): Comparison covering CAPTCHA-free SSR access, transparent pricing, and Credit Wallet refunds.

## Free vs. Premium IMEI Services

- [Free IMEI Check](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=free-imei-check): Free ($0.00) unlimited lookup returning manufacturer, model name, and basic device specs from the GSMA TAC database.
- [Apple iCloud (ON / OFF)](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-icloud-status): Paid ($0.01) Find My iPhone / Activation Lock status check.
- [Apple iCloud (Clean / Lost)](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-icloud): Paid ($0.03) Activation Lock plus Clean or Lost/Erased mode check.
- [Apple Warranty & Activation](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-warranty): Paid ($0.04) warranty coverage, activation status, and estimated purchase date.
- [Apple SIM-Lock Status](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-sim-lock): Paid ($0.05) locked vs. unlocked carrier status check.
- [Apple Check Basic & Carrier Reports](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-basic): Paid ($0.08–$0.70) carrier lock, sold-by country, and Apple Basic / Carrier Lite / Pro / Pro Plus / Max Info reports.
- [Apple MDM (ON / OFF)](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-mdm): Paid ($0.30–$0.50) Mobile Device Management corporate supervision check (optional FMI bundle).
- [Apple Full GSX Report](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=apple-full-gsx): Paid ($1.00–$4.20) GSX activation policy, sold-by info, case history, replacement, and repair history.
- [WorldWide Blacklist Check](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=blacklist): Paid ($0.05 simple / $0.10 full) GSMA lost/stolen blacklist status across global carriers.
- [Samsung Info & Knox Guard](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=samsung-info): Paid ($0.10–$0.20) Samsung device details, warranty, and Knox Guard lock status.
- [Xiaomi, Huawei & Google Pixel Checks](https://imeihub.net/service.php?slug=xiaomi-status): Paid ($0.08–$0.20) brand-specific device info and Xiaomi Mi Account lock status.

## Platform Highlights

- **Credit Wallet (No Subscriptions):** Top up your wallet via Stripe, PayPal, Binance Pay, or USDT (TRC20/BEP20) and pay only for the checks you run—from $0.01 per check.
- **Automatic Refund Guarantee:** If an upstream provider fails or returns an error on a paid check, the credit is automatically refunded to your wallet.
- **Fast & Direct Access:** Server-rendered pages with no aggressive CAPTCHA gates or forced subscriptions, built for used-phone buyers, refurbishers, resellers, and repair shops.

## Featured Guides

- [iPhone IMEI Check: Why Does One SIM Have No Mobile Data?](https://imeihub.net/article/iphone-imei-check-one-sim-no-mobile-data): Distinguish IMEI, IMEI2, and EID and isolate Dual SIM cellular data issues.
- [Does "Scam Likely" Mean I Have a Blacklisted iPhone?](https://imeihub.net/article/blacklisted-iphone-scam-likely-caller-id): Clarify carrier caller-ID labels versus GSMA IMEI blacklist status.
- [iPhone Serial Number Check: Where Is My AppleCare Proof of Coverage?](https://imeihub.net/article/iphone-serial-number-check-applecare-proof-of-coverage): How to verify AppleCare warranty coverage using serial and IMEI numbers.
- [T-Mobile IMEI Check Passed: Why Is Google Messages Still Using SMS?](https://imeihub.net/article/t-mobile-imei-check-rcs-google-messages): Troubleshoot RCS provisioning independently of IMEI compatibility.
- [Samsung Tablet IMEI Check: Why Is the 5G Option Missing?](https://imeihub.net/article/samsung-tablet-imei-check-5g-option-missing): Verify cellular radio hardware and carrier 5G band support via IMEI.
